notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]10/18/2016
notes.content:
Patch V 1.2 was released today.

PATCH NOTES
• Added high-res assets for UI. (Font, text, symbols.)

If you are still experiencing issues after the patch, or if the patch introduced new issue, please let us know on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/458730/discussions/1/361798516959964973/]the forums[/url]. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Price and Bonus Items
notes.content:
[i]Conception II: Children of the Seven Stars[/i] arrives on Steam on August 16 for 19.99 USD.
First week purchases include a 20% discount and mini-OST.
(*Mini-OST only available during first week after launch.)

The Steam port supports trading cards and offers 8 cards, 7 backgrounds and 10 emotions.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717505/70bb3a0f10b77df1954afe7df93e9e0b3345b978.png[/img]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/504270]10-song mini-soundtrack details[/url]: 
Composed by Masato Koda
Tracks 1-5, 10: Lyrics by Marie
Tracks 1-5, 10: Performed by Phantasmagoric

Contains MP3 files. 

[b]Complete Track Listing[/b] 
01.	Spicate ~7-Colored Celestial Sphere~
02.	Harvest Code
03.	A Breath’s Distance
04.	Congratulations!
05.	Dungeon Battle 1 (First Half)
06.	Melody of Footsteps (Fuuko’s Theme)
07.	Monochromatic Color (Torii’s Theme)
08.	A Piece of Courage (Narika’s Theme)
09.	The Heart’s Opposite Bank (Serina’s Theme)
10.	Eternally Holding Your Hand
